articles.title: Rejetto HFS servers now actively scanned for critical RCE flaw
articles.summary: Hackers are actively scanning for a Rejetto HFS weak signing key vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-61500, that allows session forgery, account takeover, and remote code execution (RCE). [...]

articles.title: USN-8870-1: OpenStack Aodh and Watcher vulnerability
articles.summary: Chen YuXiang discovered that OpenStack Aodh did not correctly enforce project scoping in its alarm list API and that the OpenStack Watcher webhook trigger endpoint did not apply authorization. An attacker could possibly use this issue to access sensitive alarm metadata or trigger unauthorized action plans.

articles.title: Google halts open-source bug bounty program amid AI spam surge
